This vertical editorial illustration features a black background with a red vertical stripe along the left edge. At the top, the white text "MAIN BATU BARA ALI MASYKUR MUSA" appears above a large, lime-green "TEMPO" logo. Below the logo is smaller white text: "11-17 NOVEMBER 2013".

The central area displays four stylized green human faces, arranged in two rows. Each face is tinted a monochromatic shade of lime green with visible brushstrokes and highlights. In the top-left, a man holds his hands over his ears. In the top-right, a man wearing glasses holds one hand over his mouth. In the bottom-left, a man with glasses holds his hand over his nose and mouth. In the bottom-right, a man holds both hands over his eyes.

White text between the faces reads: "SUAP GEDUNG DPR" followed by "Cerita lain di balik kasus Hambalang dan Wisma Atlet. Marzuki Alie, Anas Urbaningrum, Pius Lustrilanang, Olly Dondokambey, serta sejumlah politikus diduga ikut kebagian."

In the bottom-left corner is a white barcode with the numbers "00037" and "9 770126 427302". Adjacent text includes "RP 33.000", "WWW.TEMPO.CO", "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN", and "ISSN: 0126-4273".
